scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @prep-kit/web" "npm run dev --workspace @prep-kit/api"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @prep-kit/contracts && npm run build --workspace @prep-kit/database && npm run build --workspace @prep-kit/pipeline
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @prep-kit/api && npm run build --workspace @prep-kit/web
scripts.build:vercel:api: node scripts/validate-production-env.mjs api && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @prep-kit/api
scripts.build:vercel:web: node scripts/validate-production-env.mjs web && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @prep-kit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @prep-kit/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @prep-kit/database && npm run typecheck --workspace @prep-kit/pipeline && npm run typecheck --workspace @prep-kit/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @prep-kit/web && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
